name: Token Footer Injector
description: Appends token-usage footers to OpenClaw outbound messages. llm_output uses only the current event usage and hook-provided context budget; delivery hooks correct from sessions.json when a reliable session match exists.

maxMessageLength.description: If content plus footer exceeds this length, keep the original content and skip the footer. The plugin never truncates message content.

minContentLength.description: Minimum content length required before delivery-stage hooks add or correct a footer. Default 25.

skipAgents.description: Agent IDs that should not receive token footers.

skipChannels.description: Channel IDs or channel labels that should not receive token footers.
